messages:
alex: FYI Snyk flagged CVE-2026-2999 in `marked` (markdown renderer) — XSS via untrusted HTML. CVSSv3 6.5, EPSS 0.042. Affects images/docs-renderer service that accepts user uploads. Can someone do a quick exploitability check?

cve-bot: CVE-2026-2999 | marked < 4.2.3 | CWE-79 XSS | Link: https://snyk.io/vuln/CVE-2026-2999 | EPSS: 0.042 | Published: 2026-02-13

maria: Quick look — upstream patch available in 4.2.3. PoC on GH issues shows HTML allowed in markdown + no sanitizer => reflected XSS.

chen: Confirmed our docs-renderer uses `marked@4.1.8` in Dockerfile. It renders markdown from PR descriptions and docs site previews (authenticated but some external PR submitters exist).

alex: Key question: does exploit require unauthenticated access? If only internal-auth'd users can trigger, scope might be limited. ops-oncall can you confirm ingress rules and whether previews are public?

ops-oncall: Previews are reachable from CI preview URLs — they are not indexed but reachable via link; token-based auth for uploading, but preview URLs are public for 7 days. So external contributor could trigger via PR.

jordan: Product note: previews are intentionally shareable; can't lock them down quickly. We need mitigation that doesn't break DX.

alex: Triage suggestion: assign P2 (important but not immediate emergency). Short-term mitigations: 1) sanitize output (DOMPurify in rendering pipeline) 2) upgrade `marked` to 4.2.3 3) tighten preview TTL or require auth for preview access. Which can we do fast?

maria: Upgrade test matrix: bump to 4.2.3 in image, run full render test and smoke on staging. No breaking API expected. I can PR and run canary within 2 hours.

chen: On prod side we can add a middleware sanitize step that strips HTML tags before rendering as a quick guard. I can push a small patch behind a feature flag.

alex: Good. Plan: (A) CHEN: push sanitize middleware to staging today behind flag. (B) MARIA: open upgrade PR to 4.2.3, CI + staging canary for 24h. (C) OPS-ONCALL: reduce preview TTL to 24h temporarily and add warning to share links. (D) Security: update ticket with CVSS/EPSS and owner.

ops-oncall: I'll queue a config change to drop TTL and add a header `X-Preview-Expires` — rollback path ready.

cve-bot: Recorder: Assigned alex as owner for triage; severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 6.5); recommended action: upgrade + sanitize + access control.

alex: Exploitability checks: searched public PoC repos and Metasploit — nothing widely automated yet. EPSS low but real vector exists due to preview links. So prioritizing a fast patch + sanitize is the right call.

maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs-renderer/pull/842 — bump + lockfile. Running staging canary now.

chen: Middleware PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs-renderer/pull/843 — simple DOMPurify pipe, feature-flagged. Smoke tests passed locally.

jordan: From PM side we'll notify a few power users to avoid sharing previews until TTL change is live. Also logging: can we add an audit event when preview is rendered (who requested it)?

alex: Yes, let's add an audit log event `preview.render.request` with actor and source IP. Not blocking patch but add to follow-ups.

ops-oncall: TTL change rolled to staging; will push to prod 30m after canary verifies.

alex: OK — blocking items tracked in the ticket. Post-patch actions: update runbook, add regression eval (rendering edge cases), and schedule a postmortem if we see any exploitation attempts.

cve-bot: Status update scheduled in 6h.

maria: Canary healthy after 40m. No errors. Will schedule upgrade to prod in 45m unless objections.

chen: Sanitize middleware looks good in staging. Feature flag on.

alex: No objections. Proceed with prod upgrade + middleware enable. After deployment, we set EPSS/exp alert to watch for spikes.

jordan: Thanks everyone — will craft a short customer-facing note if needed.

ops-oncall: Prod rollout started. Will post when complete.

ops-oncall: Prod rollout complete at 1891234890. No rollback.

alex: Closing triage: action owner alex; mitigation: upgrade + sanitize + TTL reduction + audit logs; priority: P2. Will move to next steps (post-deploy monitoring & runbook update). :thumbsup:
